builds.name: Easy levelling
builds.suits: A bow or gun and a pet that fights beside you. You shoot from range while the pet holds the enemy, so most fights are easy and safe.
builds.gear: Agility first, then Stamina and Intellect. Use the hardest-hitting bow, gun or crossbow you can find.

why.Lethal Attacks: More critical strikes with all your attacks, and it opens the next row.
why.Careful Aim: Your Intellect also adds to your Attack Power, and it opens Mortal Shots.
why.Efficiency: Shots and Stings cost less Mana, so you can shoot for longer.
why.Improved Arcane Shot: Arcane Shot is ready again sooner, so you press it more often.
why.Rapid Killing: Rapid Fire is ready again sooner, and kills make your next shot hit harder.
why.Mortal Shots: Your critical strikes with ranged attacks hit much harder.
why.Trueshot Aura: Party members nearby get more ranged Attack Power, and it opens Sniper Shot.
why.Ranged Weapon Specialization: More damage every time you shoot with your bow or gun.
why.Sniper Shot: A long-range shot that also lets your next shots reach further.
why.Deadly Aspects: Your Aspect of the Hawk can make your shots come faster for a short time.
why.Endurance Training: Your pet has more Health and Armor, so it lasts longer in fights.
why.Unleashed Fury: Your pet does more damage, so fights end sooner.
why.Ferocity: Your pet lands more critical strikes.

fight: Call Pet, put Hunter's Mark on the enemy, then shoot with Auto Shot.
Add Serpent Sting, then press Arcane Shot every time it is ready.
Turn on Aspect of the Hawk before you fight and leave it on.
Press Sniper Shot to hit from far away when you pull an enemy.
Wing Clip (level 12) slows an enemy that reaches you. Step back, then shoot.
Mend Pet (level 12) heals your pet after a fight. Feed Pet when your pet is hungry.
Losing a fight? Use Concussive Shot to slow the enemy, then run.
